These are CHARTER ceilings, not exact measurements. Raising one is a deliberate
scope decision that belongs in a PR of its own, with the charter argument in the
PR body -- not a mechanical regeneration. Nothing here should ever change as a
side effect of an ordinary UAT change; if a routine PR needs a bump, that is the
signal the gate exists to raise.
Bucket membership is defined by BUCKETS in uat_loc_table.py, which stays the
single source of truth for which module sits in which bucket.
for the current per-module and per-bucket numbers.
